principles: A URL is a candidate source, not proof that its terms permit redistribution or its content is fit for a particular scale.
Do not convert missing CRS, date, license, resolution, or source metadata into a valid-looking layer.
Source availability, legal permission, attribution, resolution, currency, and scientific suitability are independent gates.
Regional biodiversity plans guide screening but do not replace statutory interpretation, landholder consent, or on-site ecological survey.
Medium/coarse remote-sensing layers are not site survey or construction geometry.
Every ingested source must later be pinned by exact source URI, observation date/version, retrieval time, content digest, CRS, transform, and attribution.

pilot.name: Johannesburg / Highveld, Gauteng, South Africa
pilot.purpose: Validate multi-scale design and source-provenance workflows before making parcel-specific claims.
pilot.known_limitation: This registry records candidate public services and metadata only. No source layer has been downloaded, legally cleared for redistribution, or field-validated by this catalog.

records.title: Gauteng Critical Biodiversity Areas / Ecological Support Areas Conservation Plan v4
records.publisher: SANBI BGIS; source attribution in the service identifies Gauteng Department of Environment and Ecosol GIS

temporal_currency.source_version: Gauteng C-Plan v4; service identifies a 2023 planning revision
temporal_currency.refresh_policy: unknown; re-check item metadata and official custodian before each ingestion

records.attribution: The service metadata reports Gauteng Department of Environment (GDEnv) and Ecosol GIS copyright.

license.note: Service metadata exposes copyright and query formats but this catalog has not established redistribution rights or a complete dataset license. Do not bundle or republish the underlying layer until terms are verified.

uses: Flag proposed interventions intersecting conservation-plan categories for further review.
Show source category, method/reference and date to the designer.
not_for: Declaring legal zoning or development approval outcome.
Replacing site-level species inventory, habitat-condition survey or permission from rights-holders.
Calculating biodiversity gain from symbol counts.
validation_gates: Verify source license, redistribution and caching permissions with custodian.
Pin retrieval date, layer definition, field schema, object counts and response digest.
Verify axis order and an independent known-location sample.
Render only at a declared scale, with a caution that site screening is not ground verification.

records.title: National Biodiversity Priority Areas 2023 composite map services
records.publisher: South African National Biodiversity Institute (SANBI) BGIS
records.access_protocol: ArcGIS REST MapServer and Feature Layers

temporal_currency.refresh_policy: review source-layer versions and custodians before every ingestion

records.attribution: SANBI is identified as the service copyright owner.

license.note: Publicly queryable service does not by itself establish redistribution rights for offline bundles or derivative datasets.

uses: Regional screening for protected areas, CBA/ESA, wetlands, rivers, and strategic water-source areas.
Show ecological constraints and data gaps before scenario generation.
not_for: Parcel certification or a substitute for official planning and environmental review.
Treating all displayed priority classes as legally identical restrictions.
Computing an overall ecological score without category-specific method and uncertainty.
validation_gates: Verify licenses for each layer, not only the composite service.
Pin layer IDs and source metadata; layers may be updated independently.
Record source scale, version/date, and no-data behavior.
Compare select features against custodian documentation.

records.title: CHIRPS v3 daily rainfall reanalysis
records.publisher: Climate Hazards Center / UCSB; catalogued in Google Earth Engine
records.reported_crs: dataset metadata must be inspected and pinned at retrieval

temporal_currency.source_version: CHIRPS v3 daily reanalysis; Earth Engine catalog showed coverage through 2026-07-31 at review time
temporal_currency.observed_at: 1981-01-01 through 2026-07-31 according to the catalog at review time
temporal_currency.refresh_policy: record exact collection version and observation window; check catalog for updates

records.attribution: Cite the Climate Hazards Center/UCSB data product and Google Earth Engine catalog when used.

license.note: Do not carry a blanket public-domain assertion from another CHIRPS version to this v3 reanalysis without verifying the specific product terms.

uses: Historical daily rainfall context and drought-season scenario inputs at regional/catchment screening scales.
Temporal stratification for scenarios and sensitivity analysis.
not_for: Parcel-level rainfall measurement or replacement for local gauges.
A design-storm hyetograph without appropriate event/statistical analysis.
Direct calibration claim for a local runoff solver.
validation_gates: Verify version-specific terms and Earth Engine access conditions.
Record collection ID, observation window, units, no-data masks, processing version, and retrieval time.
Compare a sample against an independent gauge/reference dataset before calibration use.
Disclose grid scale; do not imply 0.05-degree cells resolve property microclimates.

records.title: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (digital surface model)
records.publisher: Copernicus / ESA with DLR and Airbus source contributions
records.access_protocol: Copernicus Data Space Browser / API / bulk access subject to current account eligibility and license conditions
records.reported_crs: native download products differ; pin actual tile CRS and vertical datum per asset

temporal_currency.source_version: GLO-30; source acquisition mainly 2011–2015 according to current product documentation
temporal_currency.observed_at: source acquisition 2011–2015, with infill sources as described in product handbook
temporal_currency.refresh_policy: pin exact tile/product version and any infill/quality masks

records.attribution: Apply the source notice required by the selected Copernicus DEM product license; preserve source and modification notice in exports.

license.note: On 2026-08-25 the Copernicus Data Space announced new access restrictions for the GLO-30 view service and a 90-metre fallback when the requested instance is unspecified. Choose the explicit instance and verify current access rights instead of assuming a 30-metre default.

uses: Regional terrain context, catchment hypotheses and broad slope screening after CRS/datum checks.
Help identify where high-resolution survey or lidar is necessary.
not_for: Bare-earth terrain without filtering/validation: this is a surface model that may include vegetation and buildings.
Construction grading, drainage certification, flood level, or accessibility compliance.
Parcel design with precision finer than the data's proven accuracy.
validation_gates: Request GLO-30 explicitly and verify current account/license access.
Store actual raster CRS, vertical datum, pixel alignment, acquisition/product version, quality/error/infill masks and checksum.
Compare representative spot elevations with a trustworthy local control or better survey data.
Mark DSM versus terrain interpretation distinctly in layer metadata.

records.title: OpenStreetMap vector data
records.access_protocol: Use a permitted extract or an approved API; do not treat standard map tiles as a bulk-download API.
records.reported_geometry: mixed points, lines and polygons depending on mapped feature
records.reported_crs: published geographic data commonly uses WGS84; preserve exact source/extract metadata during ingestion

temporal_currency.source_version: changes continuously; exact extract timestamp required
temporal_currency.refresh_policy: pin extract timestamp/sequence and source digest

records.attribution: Display '© OpenStreetMap contributors' and link to https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright.

license.note: ODbL 1.0 applies; attribution is required and database/derivative distribution can trigger share-alike obligations. Review the specific use case before combining or redistributing layers.

uses: Road, trail, mapped building, public-space and connectivity context.
Identify missing or stale map features for field verification.
not_for: Cadastral ownership, statutory boundaries, utility location, or guarantees that a mapped footpath is accessible.
Treating unmapped as nonexistent.
validation_gates: Store extract timestamp, attribution and ODbL obligations with the dataset.
Inspect regional completeness and tagging consistency.
Compare routes/features to local authoritative sources and field observations.
Preserve missing-data state separately from negative/absent factual claims.

records.title: Copernicus Sentinel-2 Level-2A surface reflectance
records.access_protocol: Copernicus Data Space or a separately governed analysis provider; retain source-specific metadata
records.reported_geometry: multispectral raster; visible/NIR bands at 10 m, red-edge/SWIR at 20 m, additional bands at 60 m
records.reported_crs: per product tile; preserve projection, transform and pixel alignment from each asset

temporal_currency.source_version: Sentinel-2 L2A; provider/catalogue coverage and processing baseline must be pinned for every query
temporal_currency.refresh_policy: record scene IDs, acquisition dates, cloud/shadow masks, processing baseline and retrieval date

records.attribution: Follow the selected Copernicus/product access terms and cite the exact scene/product.

license.note: Keep the Copernicus source identity separate from the terms of any third-party hosting/analysis platform.

uses: Multi-date vegetation/land-cover change screening, with cloud, shadow and season controls.
Prioritizing sites for ground inspection and measuring broad cover trends.
not_for: Individually identifying all trees or understory species from 10-m pixels.
A species list or biodiversity gain calculation without independent field/reference evidence.
Parcel-level imperviousness precision claims without appropriate validation and scale analysis.
validation_gates: Pin exact scene IDs, dates, CRS/transform, cloud/shadow mask, processing baseline and source terms.
Test indices against known examples and independently interpreted reference sites.
Report effective pixel size and valid-data fraction per output.
Separate observed imagery classification from inferred land-cover class.

records.title: National Geo-spatial Information (CD:NGI) topographic maps and orthophoto products
records.publisher: National Geo-spatial Information, Department of Land Reform and Rural Development, South Africa
records.access_protocol: Official geoportal; select and inspect each product/sheet before retrieval. No service endpoint or bulk-download behavior is assumed by this catalog.
records.reported_geometry: Product-dependent raster orthophotos, topographic maps and other geospatial products; exact asset type must be recorded per sheet
records.reported_crs: Product-specific; official map-series references Hartebeesthoek94 datum/WGS84 ellipsoid, but the actual file CRS and axis order must be inspected for each product

temporal_currency.source_version: Exact map sheet, product series, edition and orthophoto acquisition date must be selected and pinned before use
temporal_currency.refresh_policy: Record exact sheet/product ID, edition/acquisition date and metadata. Do not treat portal access time as observation date.

records.attribution: Use the attribution and copyright notice supplied with the exact CD:NGI product; preserve it with any derived layer.

license.note: Official availability does not by itself establish permission for automated retrieval, offline bundling, redistribution or derivative products. Verify product-specific terms with CD:NGI before ingestion.

uses: Candidate authoritative local context for topographic features and orthophoto-based site screening after exact product, currency, CRS and terms are verified.
Potential higher-detail validation reference for regional/coarse remote-sensing context, subject to scale and accuracy checks.
not_for: Assuming all products are downloadable or freely redistributable.
Treating imagery or 1:50,000 mapping as a current cadastral survey, utility locate or construction-grade elevation model.
Claiming site-scale geometric accuracy without the product specification and independent control.
validation_gates: Open the exact geoportal product and record its identifier, title, edition/acquisition date and technical metadata.
Obtain the actual dataset terms and written permission where required for caching, redistribution and derivative use.
Record actual CRS, axis order, vertical datum if relevant, pixel size/map scale, accuracy and no-data behavior.
Validate representative features/elevations against an independent trusted survey or authoritative reference before any engineering use.
Keep source attribution attached to rendered views and exports.

required_before_ingestion: source version/observation date and retrieval time
native resolution and valid use scales
integration_contract.rule: A source may be visualized with a caution before model use, but a model must refuse inputs failing its CRS, resolution, license, date, or quality requirements.
